visualCharacteristics.purpose: rotating recent-winners slider with portrait, name, location, CTA, game logo and prize amount
visualCharacteristics.description: Solid blue rgb(0,157,219) heading strip with white H2 'Recent winners', followed by a light-blue patterned winners slider: circular portrait, name, location, CTA pill, game logo + 'Winner' label and large prize amount; side arrows and dots.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: [portrait image | text]. Text: heading (winner name), location paragraph, paragraph with game logo image + "Winner", prize amount paragraph (e.g. $500,000), CTA link
contentPattern.variantDescriptor: Light-blue patterned slider; circular portrait left, name/location/CTA centre, game logo + large prize amount right

usage: Rotating showcase of recent winners: circular portrait, winner name, location, CTA, game logo with Winner label and prize amount.
reuseGuidance: Use for testimonial/winner style sliders with a portrait plus a highlighted figure. Place inside a section styled heading-band-blue to get the heading strip.
